quote: Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) President and Chair Reta Jo Lewis … signed a US$500 million Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago with Minister of Finance and the Economy Colm Imbert. The MOU will develop opportunities and support financing in the maritime domain awareness, cybersecurity, renewable energy, and water sanitation sectors.
note: Opened EXIM English release 20 Jun 2024 (Trinidad MOU USD 500m).
